mapper.select: SELECT id, reimburse_no, doc_type, status, reimburser_id, department_id, company_id, business_type_id, title, reason, subsidy_amount, submit_date, create_time, remark FROM reimburse_doc WHERE (#{query.reimburseNo} = '' OR reimburse_no LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{query.reimburseNo}), '%')) AND (#{query.title} = '' OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{query.title}), '%')) AND (#{query.reason} = '' OR reason LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{query.reason}), '%')) AND (#{query.companyId} = '' OR company_id = #{query.companyId}) AND (#{query.departmentId} = '' OR department_id = #{query.departmentId}) AND (#{query.reimburserId} = '' OR reimburser_id = #{query.reimburserId}) AND (#{query.businessTypeId} = '' OR business_type_id = #{query.businessTypeId}) ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
